challenge.title: A Visit to the Pharmacy and the Doctor
challenge.instructions: Write and act out a conversation of at least 10 lines where you tell a friend how you feel, name at least two symptoms with body words, then get medicine at the pharmacy. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 9 and use both a masculine and a feminine address form (for example عامل and عاملة).
required_elements: A question about how someone feels, like عامل إيه or مالك.
At least two symptoms named with body words, such as راسي or بطني.
A specific complaint such as عندي صداع or عندي سخونية.
A question about how long, using من إمتى.
A pharmacy request using عندك or عايز.
A question about a prescription using لازم روشتة.
Instructions for taking medicine, such as مرتين في اليوم.
A closing wish ألف سلامة and its reply الله يسلمك.
